title: Iran internal crisis (2025–present)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Iran internal crisis (2025–present)", at revision 1378212209, opens: "Following the 2025 Twelve-Day War, a domestic crisis began in Iran. The period is characterized by domestic unrest, political instability, protests and economic decline within the country, to which the government of Iran responded with government crackdowns, mass executions, arrests and militarization in an effort to maintain control." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q135450775, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "political crisis in Iran". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
